[[PCS1]] ([[Pokémon Colosseum Snatchers|PCS]]) }} |} '''Wes''' (Japanese: '''レオ''' ''Leo'') is a young man who lives in the [[Orre]] region of the [[Pokémon world|world]]. He is the protagonist of [[Pokémon Colosseum]]. In the game manual, he is referred to as '''Hero'''.Pokémon Colosseum manual, page 9 ==Storyline== [[File:Colosseum Wes intro fullbody.png|thumb|left|220px|Wes during the [[game intro|intro]] of Colosseum]] Wes's past is never fully explained. He has apparently been with his {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, {{p|Umbreon}} and {{p|Espeon}}, for years. Wes joins [[Team Snagem]] for unclear reasons, but then leaves. Before he does, he plants a bomb to completely destroy Team Snagem's headquarters and steals the portable version of the [[Snag Machine]] - a device that can turn [[Poké Ball]]s into [[Snag Ball]]s - which can be used to catch Pokémon already owned by other {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. In the process Wes reveals the hidden base to the police of Orre. Equipped with this device, Wes wanders around until he rescues [[Rui]] from [[Trudly|some]] [[Folly|kidnappers]] in [[Phenac City]]. Using his high-tech hovering motorcycle to travel around [[Orre]], Wes and Rui set off to uncover the conspiracy behind [[Cipher]], [[Team Snagem]], and the [[Shadow Pokémon]]. Wes's actions eventually attract the attention of both {{p|Ho-Oh}} and {{p|Celebi}}. However, shortly after defeating Cipher and snagging/saving most of the Shadow Pokémon, there are reports that "Wes" started attacking people with a Shadow {{p|Togetic}}. Wes, with the help of News reports and [[Kids Grid]], manages to track down the impostor to [[Outskirt Stand]], where he is in the middle of attacking one of the people nearby. He then battles and defeats the impostor and snags his doppelgänger's Shadow Togetic. Afterwards, the impostor is revealed to be an ex-{{tc|Cipher Peon}} named [[Fein]] who had wanted revenge on Wes for shutting down Cipher, and declares his success in ruining Wes's reputation. However, Orre forgives Wes after realizing their mistake. His whereabouts after the events of Pokémon Colosseum are unknown. His and Rui's heroic acts in bringing the first Shadow incident to an end are remembered by people in Orre in {{Pokémon XD}}, though their names are not mentioned. ===Pokémon=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |gen=3 |ndex=0196 |pokemon=Espeon |gender=male |level=25 |type1=Psychic |ability=Synchronize |move1=Confusion|move1type=Psychic |move2=Return|move2type=Normal |move3=Reflect|move3type=Psychic |move4=Helping Hand|move4type=Normal}} {{Pokémon |gen=3 |ndex=197 |pokemon=Umbreon |game=Colo |gender=male |level=26|type1=Dark |ability=Synchronize |move1=Bite|move1type=Dark |move2=Secret Power|move2type=Normal |move3=Taunt|move3type=Dark |move4=Snatch|move4type=Dark}} {{Pokémon/Grid/end}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo=== [[File:Wes CSL.png|thumb|150px|Wes in Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo]] Wes appears in the manga adaptation of Pokémon Colosseum, [[Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo]]. {{sectionstub}} ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |width=80 |trainer=Wes |pkmn=Espeon |type1=Psychic |img=Wes Umbreon Espeon CSL.png |epnum=CSL1 |epname= |desc={{p|Espeon}} is Wes's main Pokémon.
